node.title: Re^3: How to take only maximum directory name by using its digits using perl?
node.author: hippo
node.doctext:
Did i made any mistakes with my code.

This isn't an [SSCCE]. You have neither declared nor defined $output_dir and therefore $location is undefined so LOGFILE cannot be [doc://open]ed and your while () condition will never be true.

Let me know to check it?

Item 1 of the [id://745674] is to use the stricture pragmas. This would have highlighted the problem to you.
